evidence_rules: Pre-independence/current-territory tennis is anchored only by retrospective evidence that a federation and organised tennis existed under expatriate control; it is low-confidence.
The 1975 governance transition and club-school programme are gated to 1975.
The documented 1985–2001 decline is represented as a real downward structural phase rather than smoothed away.
The 2022 FFT cooperation protocol supports development capacity only from 2022.
The 2025 Davis Cup Africa Group III promotion is used as evidence of active competition structure, not as an outcome-based rating target.
The 2026 ITF association listing confirms current institutional continuity only.
No ranking or title outcome is used as a calibration target; 9+ remains world-leading.
